Every 6 hours on Wi-Fi (an unmetered network), when the computer answers at the address: your songs, songbooks and site indexes synced both ways, and what changed on both sides left for you to choose, with a notification. When nothing answers there, it does nothing.
This library in one file: to share with another caracole, or to keep
A file another caracole exported: synced as if it were here
Pinch a page to change it: fingers apart for larger text, together for smaller, from 50% to 250% of the size Android\'s font size gives the pages. A sheet\'s own Aa sizes its text on top of this.

Offline, the app shows the pages caracole writes into your library: the library page, each sheet with its viewer (key, capo, diagrams, harmony), songbooks, and the PDFs and Guitar Pro files, which open in another app. With the computer\'s site indexes, which a sync brings, the library page\'s search finds songs on the sites too. Fetching sheets, Export and choosing versions need caracole serve, in the browser.

Copies of the phone\'s library, to restore it from: made by hand, every day and before each sync.

Each backup holds the phone\'s songs, versions, songbooks and kept files (the indexes are imported again, not backed up). Three of each kind are kept: by hand, daily (while the phone is idle) and before a sync. A restore puts the library back as it was, and keeps the cooldowns, pace and settings the phone has now; the next sync gives the restored library to the computer.
No app on this phone picks where a file goes.
The phone\'s queue is full: try again in a moment.
The songs, their versions, songbooks and kept files go back to what this backup holds, and what changed since is gone from the phone. The cooldowns, pace and settings stay as they are now.
